answer: The nursery attendance book is signed twice a day by a parent who was actually there. Proof of childcare provider registration via early years inspectorate is a book of that kind: a registration the inspectorate has renewed after annual nursery visits. One false entry needs a pen. Two hundred false entries need two hundred mornings, two hundred children who never arrived, and the velvet of each is the coat peg with a name on it — the prism is the parent at the door, the saffron the register the inspector reads aloud.
